sql.query: SELECT ct.id,ct.templateName,ct.description,ct.outputType,ct.templateKey,ct.subjectTemplate,ct.versionNumber,ct.isActive,ct.modifiedDate,COALESCE(u.displayName,'Unknown') modifiedBy FROM tbl_contract_templates ct LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=ct.modifiedByUserId WHERE ct.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=ct.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 AND ((ct.outputType='email' AND p.permissionCode='email.configure') OR (ct.outputType<>'email' AND p.permissionCode='agreements.configure'))) ORDER BY ct.isActive DESC,ct.outputType,ct.templateName
